cells.gaps: No source says a commune's link is in service: the 23 Starlink kits and subscriptions are reported as handed over (TCD-006, TCD-007), and 23 is a count with no national total of communes. TCD-005 lists municipalities among the points sending civil registration data by SMS, with no count, no place outside the capital, no statement that it is past a pilot and no connection provided to the office. TCD-001's plan is for 2027 and TCD-002 gives no period, so plan:current rests on a project whose dates the facts do not state.
cells.note: Stage 2: a connection programme has delivered kits to 23 provincial-capital communes, which is preparation until a source says the links are in use. Stage 3 needs offices outside the capital live on a connection or working in a national system at their own offices, and no fact states either.
